report_discrepancies.note: Statement of Cash Flows (modified cash) Total column prints Net increase (decrease) in cash (182,257) and ending cash 652,612, but the fund columns add to (311,981) and 159,409 (Total omits the interfund balances line (129,724)).

notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental balances are fund balances of the governmental funds (p6), Total column; identity 3,673,214 + 2,122,703 - 2,415,881 + 125,000 - 125,000 + 2,668 insurance proceeds = 3,382,704. Taxes 446,266 split using the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2), which tie to the fund schedules (General p14, Street/Fire p16, TIF p19). Intergovernmental 1,129,365 split by the fund schedules' printed lines (p14, p16, p19). Other 215,832 split: NPPD lease 166,540 and franchise fees 10,145 (p2) with the remaining fund 'Other' lines 39,147. Business-type from the modified cash proprietary statement (pp9-10) Total column, measure net position; receipts total computed from operating + nonoperating revenues; disbursements total 892,569 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) Total column, because it includes capital assets, internal balances and enterprise debt. Detail: General Fund by department (pp14-15), major special revenue funds Street, Fire, Ambulance, CCC Inn from p16-17, nonmajor funds Recycling, Community Development, TIF from p19 (not repeated from p16; Hoferer Trust has no activity), and the accrual-basis proprietary statement (pp20-21) by utility fund. The all-funds budget schedule (p13) is not recorded because every fund is covered by a more detailed schedule (it combines all funds incl. utilities in one column); proprietary cash flow statement is modified cash so proprietary is null.
